knownTotals.note: 162 regular species plus 16 legendary animals. Horses and fish have their own compendium sections and are not in this 178.

Wild animals that can be skinned. Livestock is excluded. The published community list names only 70; this file adds #143 Northern Water Snake as the likely 71st (see disputes).

Blue and Yellow Macaw, Great Green Macaw, Scarlet Macaw, Red-footed Booby, Red Boa, Rainbow Boa, Sunglow Boa, Fer-de-Lance. Cuban Land Crab and Green Iguana also live on Guarma but spawn at Flat Iron Lake too, so they ARE required.

trophies.name: Zoologist
trophies.officialDescription: Study every animal across all states in Story Mode.
trophies.earnedWhen: A late-game or post-game grind. About 16 required species live only in New Austin, which Arthur cannot enter, so the trophy realistically finishes in the Epilogue or after the credits.
howTo: Track progress under Pause Menu > Progress > Compendium > Animals.
When an animal is close, aim at it with binoculars and press R1 when the Study prompt appears. Tracking alone does not count.
Study every sub-species and breed separately: all 12 dogs except Rufus, the cat, chickens and roosters, pigs, bulls, oxen, the cow, the goat, sheep, the mule and the donkey.
Do not bother with Guarma-only animals, legendary animals, the Carolina Parakeet or Rufus. All 152 required species can be found on the main map.
Get the Cuban Land Crab and Green Iguana at Flat Iron Lake. They spawn there as well as on Guarma.
Do New Austin species (desert pronghorns, desert bighorn, peccary, gila monster, condor, quail, Rio Grande turkey, Californian horned owl and others) as John in the Epilogue.
Find owls and bats at night. To cycle spawns, sleep at a camp or save, quit to the menu and continue.
tips: PowerPyx names Bear Claw, near Manzanita Post, as the best spot for mixed birds and all three common owl types.
If an aggressive animal won't hold still, hit it with a poison throwing knife. It walks off and can then be studied.
Always study first, then kill and skin. This also progresses Skin Deep.

trophies.name: Skin Deep
trophies.officialDescription: Skin every species of animal in Story Mode.
trophies.earnedWhen: Alongside Zoologist, usually in the Epilogue because several required species live only in New Austin.
howTo: Skin every wild species in the compendium that yields a pelt, hide or skin. The community figure is 71 species; see the compendium-animals:study-and-skin set.
Livestock and domestic animals (bulls, cows, oxen, pigs, sheep, goats), dogs, cats, the mule, the donkey and horses are not needed.

Small birds and rodents that are plucked or go straight into the satchel are not needed. Some large birds are needed (ducks, geese, herons, egrets, loons, pheasants, turkeys, the prairie chicken and the roseate spoonbill).
Guarma-only animals and legendary animals are not needed.
Check a species' Skinned status in the compendium after skinning. A PowerPyx reader reported a Western Moose that did not register until he skinned another one.
tips: Skin the Green Iguana on the largest island in Flat Iron Lake.
Farm snakes in the swamp around Shady Belle.

trophies.name: It was THIS Big!
trophies.officialDescription: Catch a fish weighing at least 16 lbs (7.3 kg).
trophies.earnedWhen: Usually pops on its own while catching the heavier legendary fish for A Fisher of Fish.
howTo: Start A Fisher of Fish (Jeremy Gill, north shore of Flat Iron Lake, south-east of Flatneck Station). It opens after the Chapter 2 mission 'A Fisher of Men'.
Buy the Special Lake, River and Swamp Lures ($20 each) at the bait shop in Lagras.
Catch a large legendary fish such as the Lake Sturgeon (railroad bridge south-west of Saint Denis) or the Longnose Gar (Bayou Nwa). Both are listed at over 40 lbs.

trophies.name: Trusty Steed
trophies.officialDescription: Reach max bonding level with a horse.
trophies.earnedWhen: Comes naturally during the story if you keep one horse.
howTo: Keep the same horse and reach bonding level 4 (Pause Menu > Player > Horse shows bonding).
Pet it (L3 when calming), feed it horse treats, brush it when dirty, and ride without draining its stamina core.
Automatic travel (cinematic autopilot) also builds bonding passively.
tips: No story trophy requires owning or riding several horse breeds. 'Horses for Courses' is a Red Dead Online trophy. For 100% you only discover any 10 horse breeds in the compendium and reach bonding level 4.

trophies.name: Grin and Bear it
trophies.officialDescription: Survive 18 bear attacks and kill the bear each time in Story Mode.
trophies.earnedWhen: Deliberate grind. PowerPyx estimates 5-10 hours because bear spawns are random.
howTo: Let a bear grab you, press Circle to escape, then kill it during the struggle sequence.
Use a strong rifle such as a fully upgraded Carbine Repeater with Express ammo.
Hunt between Wallace Station and Watson's Cabin. Alternatives are east of the legendary bear area and around Barrow Lagoon.
If no bear appears, move away, make camp, sleep until morning and return. Bears show up mostly in the morning and at midday.
Track progress on the Rockstar Social Club.

missables.what: Eight Guarma-only species: Blue and Yellow Macaw, Great Green Macaw, Scarlet Macaw, Red-footed Booby, Red Boa, Rainbow Boa, Sunglow Boa, Fer-de-Lance
missables.deadline: Leaving Guarma at the end of the Chapter 5 Guarma missions
missables.recommendedTiming: Optional. Only for a full compendium; not needed for any trophy.
missables.why: Guarma can't be revisited. These species don't count for Zoologist or Skin Deep.
howTo: While on Guarma in Chapter 5, study the macaws and booby with binoculars.
PowerPyx: all four Guarma snakes can be farmed at one spot, under the letter 'E' of 'Arroyo De La Vibora' on the map. Kill one, then advance time or quit and continue for another species.

missables.deadline: Killing all 25 parakeets in the Bayou (they do not respawn)
missables.recommendedTiming: Optional. Study one with binoculars the first time you see one in Bayou Nwa.
missables.why: Not needed for Zoologist, Skin Deep or 100% (Fandom, PowerPyx readers, rdr2.org). Only relevant for a complete compendium.
howTo: Study a parakeet in Bayou Nwa instead of shooting the flock.

missables.what: Pelt from a legendary animal killed and not skinned
missables.deadline: Each legendary animal spawns only once per save; after it dies (even to an NPC or predator) it never comes back
missables.recommendedTiming: Skin every legendary right after you kill it.
missables.why: Legendary animals are not needed for Zoologist or Skin Deep. Any 5 kills count for 100%, and the Giaguaro kill is Master Hunter 10. PowerPyx says a lost legendary pelt is sent to the Trapper anyway.
howTo: Skin immediately. Skinning a legendary also completes its compendium Study.

notes: The Animal compendium has 178 entries (#1-#162 regular, #163-#178 legendary), in the same order as the in-game compendium. Horses and fish are separate compendium sections (sources: ppx-animals, fandom-species).

No Zoologist or Skin Deep species is story-missable. The two Guarma animals that are required (Cuban Land Crab, Green Iguana) also spawn around Flat Iron Lake. The PowerPyx trophy guide separately notes one missable lion from a stranger mission that doesn't count (sources: ppx-animals, ppx-trophy).
No source reports any animal that exists only in the Chapter 2 area (sources checked: ppx-animals, ppx-trophy, fandom-trophies).

Species whose compendium habitat is only New Austin can't practically be done as Arthur and are left for the Epilogue: Nine-Banded Armadillo, Californian Condor, Banded Gila Monster, Desert Iguana, Collared Peccary, Californian Horned Owl, Sonoran and Baja California Pronghorn (buck and doe), California Quail, Desert Bighorn Ram and Sheep, Black-tailed Rattlesnake, Sonoran Desert Toad, Rio Grande Wild Turkey. This list is built from the compendium habitat text; some may also spawn at the edges of West Elizabeth (sources: ppx-animals).
Night-only species: Little Brown Bat, Silver Fox (mostly night), Californian/Coastal/Great Horned Owl (sources: ppx-animals).

Legendary animals are not needed for Zoologist or Skin Deep. For 100% (Best in the West) you need any 5 legendary kills; Master Hunter 10 (part of the 90 challenges needed for 100%) needs the Giaguaro Panther (sources: ppx-leg, fandom-100, fandom-challenges).

Legendary pelts go to the Trapper (Saint Denis, plus other trapper locations) for unique outfit pieces. Legendary parts such as claws and horns go to Fences for talismans and trinkets. Neither is needed for a trophy (sources: fandom-bharati, fandom-bullgator, gr-leg, ppx-leg).

Satchels are crafted by Pearson at camp, not the Trapper. Each of the 6 category satchels needs a camp milestone and perfect pelts. The Legend of the East satchel needs all 6 plus perfect Deer, Cougar and Wolf pelts. In the Epilogue, John can buy missing satchels at a Fence. No trophy and no 100% requirement involves satchels (sources: fandom-satchel, fandom-100).

Satchel pelt totals for everything: 7 perfect Deer, 2 perfect Elk, and one each of perfect Bison, Raccoon, Badger, Squirrel, Boar, Iguana, Panther, Beaver, Rabbit, Cougar and Wolf (sources: fandom-satchel).

Best in the West (100%) animal and fishing parts: discover any 50 animal species, any 10 fish species and any 10 horse breeds; reach bonding level 4 with a horse; kill any 5 legendary animals; complete 'A Fisher of Fish' (13 legendary fish) and 'Duchesses and Other Animals' (sources: fandom-100, ppx-leg, ppx-fish).

Related challenges (needed for 100%): Survivalist 9 = catch a fish of at least 19 lbs; Survivalist 10 = catch one of each fish type; Master Hunter 5 = skin 3 bears; Master Hunter 6 = kill 5 cougars with a bow and skin them; Master Hunter 10 = kill the Giaguaro Panther (sources: fandom-challenges).

Horse trophies in Story Mode: only Trusty Steed (bonding level 4). No story trophy asks for a number of horse breeds; 'Horses for Courses' (own 5 horses) is a Red Dead Online trophy (sources: fandom-trophies, ppx-trophy).

Legendary fish can't be sold, cooked or donated; they are only mailed to Jeremy Gill at a Post Office. Large ones must be carried on your horse to the post office, while small ones go in the satchel. If you lose one, catch it again (sources: ppx-fish, fandom-fishing).

Any special lure (Lake, River or Swamp) works on every legendary fish; the 'right' lure only speeds up the bite. Don't use bait. Press R2/L2 once to attract fish if nothing bites for about a minute (sources: ppx-fish, fandom-fishing).

A Fisher of Fish rewards: 1 fish mailed gives a Lake Lure; 10 give $45 and fish meat; 13 bring Jeremy Gill's invitation for Part II, which can't arrive before Epilogue Part II (sources: fandom-fisher-of-fish).

disputes.topic: Number of animals required for Zoologist
disputes.details: Most sources exclude the same groups (legendaries, 8 Guarma species, Carolina Parakeet, Rufus), giving 152. One smaller guide gives a very different number.

positions.claim: 152 species (178 minus 16 legendary, 8 Guarma, the Carolina Parakeet and Rufus)
165 for Zoologist and 151 for Skin Deep

disputes.suggestedHandling: Use 152 and the compendium-animals:study and :study-and-skin sets. Tell players to study anything they see anyway; it costs nothing.

disputes.topic: Whether Rufus (Epilogue dog) is required for Zoologist
disputes.details: Rufus is excluded only by the TrueAchievements count (152 only works if he is left out) and a PowerPyx reader comment ('nor a dog from the Epilogue'). Fandom's trophy description mentions only Guarma animals and the Carolina Parakeet.

positions.claim: Not mentioned as an exclusion (description only excludes Guarma animals and the Carolina Parakeet)

disputes.suggestedHandling: Tell players to study Rufus at Beecher's Hope in the Epilogue anyway. It's trivial and removes the risk.

disputes.topic: Whether the Carolina Parakeet is required
disputes.details: The PowerPyx guide lists it with no exclusion note, and a 2025 PowerPyx reader asked whether it is needed.

positions.claim: Not required for Zoologist or Skin Deep
Listed as a normal entry with no exclusion note

disputes.suggestedHandling: Mark it not required, but suggest studying one with binoculars in Bayou Nwa if the player sees one.

disputes.topic: Skin Deep list: 71 vs 70 named animals, and livestock
disputes.details: The only full list found (a PowerPyx reader comment) claims 71 but names 70. The only main-map snake it leaves out is #143 Northern Water Snake. Fandom's trophy description lists the non-skinnable exclusions (dogs, cats, mules, donkeys, horses, 10-foot red boa, Guarma, parakeet) but says nothing about livestock. PowerPyx itself only says 'everything with a pelt'.

positions.claim: 71 wild animals; livestock (cows, bulls, oxen, pigs, sheep, goats) not required
Every skinnable species, with no livestock exclusion mentioned

disputes.suggestedHandling: Use the 71-entry study-and-skin set (70 named plus Northern Water Snake). Tell players that if the trophy doesn't pop, they should skin one of each livestock type (bulls, ox, cow, pigs, sheep, goat) as a fallback, and re-check each species' Skinned status in the compendium.

disputes.topic: When the Legendary Bullgator becomes huntable

positions.claim: After 'That's Murfree Country' (Chapter 5, after returning from Guarma)

disputes.suggestedHandling: Tell players it's reliably available after 'That's Murfree Country'. It isn't needed for any trophy anyway.

disputes.topic: Legendary animal locations that differ between the in-game compendium and guides
disputes.details: The compendium habitat text (PowerPyx quotes it) differs from where guides say the animals actually spawn, for the Coyote (compendium: The Heartlands; guides: Scarlett Meadows), the Bighorn Ram (compendium: Grizzlies West; guides: Cattail Pond near Valentine) and the Beaver (compendium: Elysian Pool; guides: Butcher Creek). GamesRadar also labels the Beaver 'Lemoyne' and the Moose 'Ambarino', but both places are in Roanoke Ridge, New Hanover. For the Giaguaro, Fandom and PowerPyx say south-east of Bolger Glade, while GamesRadar says west of Shady Belle.

positions.claim: Map spawn points as given in the legendary-animals set

disputes.suggestedHandling: Use the guide spawn areas. Tell players to go to the legendary map icon and wait for the 'Legendary Animal Territory' prompt before searching for clues.

positions.claim: 13 (the ones needed for A Fisher of Fish and 100%)
14 (adds the catfish from A Fisher of Fish Part II)
15 (also adds the Northern Pike from The Veteran)

disputes.suggestedHandling: Show 13 as required, with the Channel Catfish and Northern Pike as optional extras.

disputes.topic: Recommended special lure for some legendary fish
disputes.details: Sources disagree on the lure for the Largemouth Bass (River vs Lake), Redfin Pickerel (Lake vs River) and Bullhead Catfish (River vs Swamp).

positions.claim: Any special lure works on every legendary fish

disputes.suggestedHandling: Tell players to carry all three special lures; the lure only changes bite speed.

disputes.topic: Legendary Rock Bass availability for Arthur
disputes.details: Aurora Basin is in Tall Trees, which Arthur can see on the map. Fandom and Game Rant still say the fish is Epilogue-only; Game Rant blames the sniper that kills Arthur in that area. PowerPyx doesn't mention a restriction.
disputes.suggestedHandling: Tell players to leave the Rock Bass, Redfin Pickerel and Largemouth Bass for the Epilogue.
